title: P2 health: response
description: Answer of P2 health to the monitoring system. alive is true only when the store answers and the ticks of all background loops are on time; when false there is a reason. Only numbers, no tenant data (MON-2, CAP-5, OBS-4, OBS-9, MON-11, LCY-6).

drain_until_s.description: Seconds until the drain deadline for reason draining.

store_free_bytes.description: Free space of the store volume in bytes (CAP-5).

store_free_ratio.description: Share of free space of the store volume (CAP-5).

oldest_urgent_age_s.description: Age of the oldest task of classes 1 and 2 in submitted (OBS-9).

delivered_10m_ratio.description: Share of deliveries that reached delivered within 10 minutes (OBS-9).

loop_tick_age_s.description: Tick age of each background loop in seconds (OBS-4).

monitor_export_age_s.description: Age of the last successful E5 export per tenant (MON-11).
